notes.subject: גלה / להגלותך
notes.rationale: Same root for exile (kalabusim Zion) and uncover (skrukim Edom) — poetic reversal, lost in Tok Pisin

notes.subject: גלה על חטאתיך
notes.rationale: 'uncover your sins' (majority) vs YLT 'exile you because of your sins' — same verb as v22a

notes.subject: kalabusim
notes.rationale: גלה literally 'denude/exile'; rendered kalabusim (send to captivity) for the Zion half

notes.subject: pikinini meri bilong Tsiyon, pikinini meri bilong Edom
notes.rationale: Twin direct addresses contrasting Zion's completed punishment with Edom's coming one

translation: Rong bilong yu i pinis, pikinini meri bilong Tsiyon; em i no ken kalabusim yu moa. Em i painimaut ⟨את⟩ rong bilong yu, pikinini meri bilong Edom; em i skrukim olgeta ⟨את⟩ ol rong bilong yu.
